command: set -euo pipefail; for task_file in $(rg -l '^theme: F$' tasks/active tasks/backlog -g '*.md' | sort); do task_id=$(awk '/^id:/{print $2; exit}' "$task_file"); deps=$(awk '/^depends_on:/{line=$0; sub(/^depends_on:[[:space:]]*/,"",line); print line; in_deps=1; next} in_deps && /^  - /{printf "%s ",$2; next} in_deps{in_deps=0}' "$task_file" | tr '\n' ' '); goal=$(awk '/^## Goal/{getline; while($0==""){getline}; sub(/^- /,""); print; exit}' "$task_file"); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$task_id" "$task_file" "$deps" "$goal"; done
command_display: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; for task_file in $(rg -l '"'"'^theme: F$'"'"' tasks/active tasks/backlog -g '"'"'*.md'"'"' | sort); do task_id=$(awk '"'"'/^id:/{print $2; exit}'"'"' "$task_file"); deps=$(awk '"'"'/^depends_on:/{line=$0; sub(/^depends_on:[[:space:]]*/,"",line); print line; in_deps=1; next} in_deps && /^  - /{printf "%s ",$2; next} in_deps{in_deps=0}'"'"' "$task_file" | tr '"'"'\n'"'"' '"'"' '"'"'); goal=$(awk '"'"'/^## Goal/{getline; while($0==""){getline}; sub(/^- /,""); print; exit}'"'"' "$task_file"); printf '"'"'%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n'"'"' "$task_id" "$task_file" "$deps" "$goal"; done'
